extracted.name: Blueberry, Banana, and Peanut Butter Smoothie
extracted.description: This is a perfect peanut butter and berry smoothie to start your day or enjoy as a snack. Flax gives a boost to this recipe. It’s kid-friendly too!
instruction_lines: Put flaxseed meal into a blender to grind and further break down.
Place banana, milk, blueberries, yogurt, peanut butter, and honey into the blender. Cover and purée until smooth.
